notes: Two Account Summary/Account Detail sections are concatenated: the first detail table is on pages 2-3 and the second begins on page 5. Detail headers repeat. Policy Number: and Policy Term: are block headers above groups of rows; the summary also has a Policy Number column split from Prefix. Each claim/coverage entry uses a two-line layout. TOTAL closes each policy-term block and GRAND TOTAL is an aggregate, not a claim. One claim number is printed on two separate coverage lines, so there are 6 displayed claim/coverage rows although the summaries count 3 and 2 claims. Date Received is the report/notification-date field; no closed-date date is printed.
